createdFor: Design approval only; UI and RAW transfer implementation await selection

variants.title: 方案 A · 浅色直观
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished HIGH-FIDELITY CHINESE MOBILE APP DESIGN REVIEW BOARD, NOT a photograph. The supplied actual Huevia app screenshot is the visual/persistent-navigation reference and edit target. Preserve its off-white canvas, near-black text, generous rounded corners, oversized “同步” heading, restrained warm-grey surfaces and the four-tab floating bottom navigation. Brand is Huevia (formal name, no migration wording). Flat front-facing 2D app screens, NO physical device, NO perspective, NO outer hardware. Create TWO tall full mobile screens side by side, large enough for crisp readable Chinese text, on a neutral review board. Left = before starting, right = receiving. Board title outside the app. All screens belong to one same app page, NOT new routes. Make central CTA impossible to miss, minimum 60 logical pixels high / approximately 70% of preview width.
Persistent top: “同步” left, green dot with “Z6_2 · 已连接” right. A pill segmented control “相机照片 / 边拍边传 / 已下载”, middle selected. Under it project selector “人像拍摄” with small chevron and “接收记录”. Bottom pill navigation: “预设 / 同步 / 相册 / 设置”, 同步 selected dark with camera icon. Correct simple icons with distinct meanings.
The main receiver preview frame retains the same size and position between idle and receiving, a wide rounded roughly 4:3 area. Idle: large single primary button EXACT “开始边拍边传” centered inside this preview frame, play symbol, clear supporting line “拍摄后自动接收新照片”. Two mutually exclusive selectable formats ONLY: “JPEG” and “RAW 原片”. Never add a third JPEG+RAW option. The format chooser is obvious before starting, and selection is read-only while receiving.
Running: replace idle CTA with the LATEST RECEIVED STILL PHOTO of an original adult portrait (tasteful natural photographic portrait), not video/live-view. Keep original photo fully visible. A compact top status badge, filename and format must agree. No blinking, no fake waveform, no red REC, no “实时取景”. A visible “停止边拍边传” secondary button is BELOW the preview, not covering the image. Under it compact counters and a three-image received-thumbnail strip. No “load more” button, no tech implementation jargon. Keep visual hierarchy calm and native, authentic to reference. Chinese must be accurate and legible, avoid filler text. Each variant should look implementable, not a promotional poster.
Variant A: Recommended closest continuation of the present app. Board title EXACT “A · 浅色直观”; small captions above screen columns “开始前” and “接收中”. Palette warm ivory #F8F7F4, charcoal #252522, grey #ECEAE4, white #FFFFFF, green #47785E. Use a LIGHT warm-grey empty preview with a subtle thin camera-arrow outline icon above the CTA, black pill CTA with white bold lettering. Put a clearly labeled “传输格式” JPEG/RAW segmented selector directly ABOVE the preview, JPEG selected black. The preview CTA is THE focal point, not the page header. Format helper below selector: “JPEG 适合快速预览”. Receiving right: format remains JPEG, status “正在接收”, filename EXACT “DSC_0123.JPG”, counters “已接收 12 张 · 待接收 1 张”. Right preview is an elegant natural portrait with no washout. Stop button neutral warm grey with a square stop icon. Maintain generous but efficient spacing, preview around the visual middle and avoid acres of dead blank space. Do not introduce yellow.

Variant C: Board title EXACT “C · 格式优先”; captions “开始前” and “接收中”. Same light Huevia brand and persistent navigation. Make format choice exceptionally clear using TWO LARGE side-by-side selection cards directly ABOVE the preview, in a compact labeled group “接收格式”. JPEG card: tiny photo outline icon, heading “JPEG”, caption “快速预览”. RAW card: file outline icon, heading “RAW 原片”, caption “保留更多细节”. RAW is selected with a thick charcoal outline and a small checkmark; JPEG is unselected. No double selection. Add ONE concise helper line under cards EXACT “相机需设为 RAW 或 RAW+JPEG”; this explains camera capture setting, it is NOT a third app-format option. Light neutral empty preview, centered big BLACK pill CTA EXACT “开始边拍边传” with white bold text and a play icon; supporting small text “RAW 文件较大，传输更久”. Running right uses the same layout with RAW selected read-only, latest adult portrait still displayed in the preview. Top badge EXACT “RAW · DSC_0123.NEF”, lower summary “已接收 8 张 · 等待下一张”, a clear “停止边拍边传” button below frame and thumbnail strip with consistent RAW badges. Never label the received NEF as JPG. Make this version excellent for a user deciding between browsing speed and original photo detail. Keep choice cards compact enough for preview and CTA to remain prominent without scrolling.
